summary: Trim ECMAScript whitespace at the start.

target.notes: Remove exactly ECMAScript WhiteSpace and LineTerminator code points. Do not rely on .NET Trim() default set, which is not specified by ECMAScript.

semantics.encoding: operate at code-point boundaries but preserve all other UTF-16 data

caveats: Whitespace membership has changed historically with Unicode/spec revisions; helper should follow the targeted ECMAScript edition.

tests.name: ordinary space
tests.expected_behavior: removes spaces only on the requested side(s)

tests.name: zero width space is not trimmed
tests.expected_behavior: U+200B remains because it is not ECMAScript whitespace
